manual_check: no_oversell failed 1 of 13 runs on plain Medusa 2.22.0: violation, cause not isolated, no case's scoring control clears it
hypothesis: createReservationItems_ reads inventory levels (ensureInventoryLevels, a plain list with no row lock) and then writes reserved_quantity as the absolute value read earlier plus the adjustment. When two complete calls reserve the same inventory level concurrently, possibly on two servers so the in-memory locks do not serialize them, both can read the same reserved_quantity and one increment is lost. I expect the level's reserved_quantity to differ from the sum of live reservations, failing reserved_matches_reservations. Many carts on the seeded WIDGET stock (10 units, one unit each) are raced across two servers to widen the window.
